description:
*“An office romance where you find yourself hopelessly entangled with the exact type of junior colleague you hate”*

Han Song-I, who, despite her outstanding work performance, constantly has her credit stolen by a clique within her team. But another source of stress arises for her. Kim Ji-Hun, a hopelessly unprofessional rookie who’s been a thorn in her side since his first day on the job. When Ji-Hun moves into Song-I’s neighborhood, the two start running into each other more often. In the process, Ji-Hun helps Song-I get rid of her clingy ex-boyfriend and even takes down a man she considered her sworn enemy. As a result, Song-I begins to develop a personal fondness for Ji-Hun…

Is romance even possible with a junior colleague who’s as stubborn as a dog—biting when provoked and turning fierce when you try to protect her?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
